mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT BIZ_YR /* 사업연도 */ FROM SDA400 A /* 서비스사업 */
SELECT INST_NM, INST_NO FROM SAA000 WHERE UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = 'U10'

SELECT PVSN_RESRCE_NM /* 제공자원명 */ ,RESRCE_NO /* 자원번호 */ ,RSFR_INST_NO /* 기관번호 */ FROM SDA100 A /* 자원기본 */
WHERE (SELECT UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD FROM SAA000 /* 통합기관 */ WHERE INST_NO = A.RSFR_INST_NO) = 'U10'

SELECT PROGRM_TTL_NM, PROGRM_NO FROM SDA300 A /* 자원프로그램 */ LEFT JOIN SDA100 B /* 자원기본 */ ON A.RESRCE_NO = B.RESRCE_NO
WHERE (SELECT UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD FROM SAA000 /* 통합기관 */ WHERE INST_NO = B.RSFR_INST_NO) = 'U10'

SELECT /* isry.aimns.cmmn.mapper.AimnsMapper.SelectSrngTrprDetail (내일이룸 심사대상자상세정보)*/ T1.TRPR_INFO_NO AS TRPR_INFO_NO /* 대상자번호*/ , T1.PAPERS_SRNG_PASS_SE_CD AS PAPERS_SRNG_PASS_SE_CD /* 서류심사합격구분코드*/ , T1.PREPAR_SCHL_PTCPTN_SE_CD AS PREPAR_SCHL_PTCPTN_SE_CD /* 예비학교참여구분코드*/ , T1.PSNCPA_ELSE_REG_SE_CD AS PSNCPA_ELSE_REG_SE_CD /* 정원이외등록구분코드*/ , T1.FRST_RGTR_ID AS FRST_RGTR_ID /* 최초등록자아이디*/ , T1.FRST_REG_DT AS FRST_REG_DT /* 최초등록일시*/ , T1.LAST_MDFR_ID AS LAST_MDFR_ID /* 최종수정자아이디*/ , T1.LAST_MDFCN_DT AS LAST_MDFCN_DT /* 최종수정일시*/ FROM AFA400 T1 /* 심사대상자*/ WHERE 1 = 1 AND T1.TRPR_INFO_NO = #{TRPR_INFO_NO} /* 대상자번호*/
